scope: Beta release of the single-machine CSV/CLI and invoice JSON workflow with 46 currencies, exact currency-specific minor units, per-currency certified totals and preserved legacy CSV replay. Exact source/tag commit is checked separately by the manual release workflow.
known_limitations: Actual fresh Google Colab upload/run/resume/download/restore acceptance remains not_run.
The 0.3.0 Windows/macOS smoke matrix is not yet verified at release preparation; prior 0.2.1 platform evidence is historical, and the full fault-injection suite remains scoped to Linux.
No exchange-rate conversion or cash rounding; each document must use one supported currency, and excess decimal precision is rejected.
Experimental Python API; persisted invoice JSON jobs using Agent version 1 require their prior runtime or a new job/workspace. Legacy CSV batches preserve their original currency contract.
Sequential document processing; original absolute workspace path required for backup restoration; no production SLA.
